displayName: Track all your competitors in one weekly digest
summary: Monitor every major competitor automatically and get a single weekly report on what changed.

useCases.title: Track all your competitors in one weekly digest
useCases.message: Help me set up monitoring across all my key competitors. You might want to start by identifying them from what you know about my company and product. If the list needs updating, ask. Then set up a Routine that checks each competitor weekly for changes to their product, pricing, messaging, or content, and sends me a combined digest.
